channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Republicans break ranks, but Senate fails to curb Trump’s Iran war powers
item.description: The bill falls short, but vote shows cracks are growing in the Republican support for the US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Netanyahu visited UAE in ‘secret’ during US-Israel war on Iran, office says
item.description: The Israeli prime minister's office describes trip as a 'historic breakthrough' in relations with Gulf state.

item.title: Drug overdose deaths drop in United States for third year in a row
item.description: Experts cite range of factors as overdose deaths drop to nearly 70,000 in 2025, a 14 percent decline over previous year.

item.title: Trump-Xi summit: China’s help in Iran may require US concessions
item.description: Analysts say China may seek changes in US policy towards Taiwan if it were to pressure Iran to reopen Hormuz.

item.title: Church leaders killed in latest ethnic violence in India’s Manipur
item.description: Protests were held after three church leaders were killed and three others injured in India’s Manipur state.

item.title: Russia places UK ex-Defence Minister Ben Wallace on wanted list
item.description: Wallace last year recommended helping Ukraine carry out a strike on the bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea.

item.title: Trade, Iran and Taiwan on the agenda as Trump arrives in China for high-stakes talks with Xi
item.description: The US president says his first request to Xi would be to "open up" China, while Beijing is expected to press Trump on the status of Taiwan.

item.title: Israeli strikes on cars in southern Lebanon kill 12, health ministry says
item.description: Two children are among those reported dead after seven cars were struck in separate attacks south of Beirut.

item.title: Deadly Russian drone attacks on Ukraine resume after ceasefire expires
item.description: Six people have been killed after Zelensky warned of "more waves" of Russian strikes through Wednesday.

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.
